channel.title: Paul Lauren Designs Journal
channel.description: Scottsdale interior design studio led by Lauren Rautbord and Kendra Vaughn — serene, uncluttered, quietly luxurious homes.

item.title: Designing for Desert Light: How to Let a Scottsdale Home Breathe
item.description: How light, heat and views shape a serene Scottsdale interior, with practical guidance on palettes, fabrics, window treatments and materials for desert homes.

item.title: The Quiet Luxury of a Neutral Palette
item.description: Why a neutral palette is anything but boring: how to layer warm whites, stone, wood and texture into an interior that feels sumptuous, calm and timeless.

item.title: Furnishing a Second Home: Mountain Cabins, Lake Houses & Desert Retreats
item.description: How to design and fully outfit a second home, whether a mountain cabin, lake house or desert retreat, so it's ready the day you arrive.

item.title: What to Expect When Working With a Luxury Interior Designer
item.description: A step-by-step look at a full-service interior design project, from the first conversation and concept through procurement, installation and the reveal.
